caseNameFull: Elizabeth S. Prentiss v. Mark Eisner, Collector of Internal Revenue, etc.

opinions.text: October 25, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied. Mr. Royall Victor and Mr. Philip L. Miller for petitioner. The Solicitor General and Mrs. Annette Abbott Adams, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.
